notes.title: New update: Checkpoints!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32765519/f2e2bf303ab1a983299dc2f14a5706e373735964.jpg

We have received a lot of requests for checkpoints to be added to the game. We heard you and we are happy to announce that checkpoints have now been added in the Story Mode !

We hope this will help new players have an easier time in their first playthrough so that more players can reach the Competitive and Speedrun modes of the game.
More players = More competition = More fun !

These checkpoints will also be a useful tool for competitive players wanting to practice a specific trick in a level without having to restart from the beginning each time.

Overall the experience should be more enjoyable. :)


Please keep sharing your feedback, feature requests or bug reports in the steam forums or in the community discord so we can keep improving the game together.

Wether you want to learn some speed strats, share your records or simply chat with like-minded players, you can join the Impulsion official discord here:
https://discord.gg/g5CDbhD

And to celebrate this update, Impulsion will be on sale for a limited time period !

Good Luck & Have Fun !

notes.title: First week feedback and new features!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32765519/f2e2bf303ab1a983299dc2f14a5706e373735964.jpg

It has been one week since Impulsion has been released and we are very pleased with your feedback so far.
In this small time window, a new community has been created, tons of speedruns and new world records have been achieved and a lot of rage has been felt in the videos and streams of the game.

Thanks to your feedback a lot of improvements and new features have already been added to the game!

List of new features:
    
    A speedometer can now be displayed to show your speed
    A confirmation window has been added for the teleporters in the starting rooms to prevent any unintentional level loads
    A developer icon has been added next to the developer times so you can try to beat us!
    In the speedrun leaderboard, the number of retries needed during the run is now displayed
    You can now jump with the mousewheel
    You can now reset a speedrun from the pause menu
    In speedrun mode, the name and timer of the current level can now be displayed
    A new achievement for 10,000 deaths has been added ! We didn't expect you to like death so much


Bug fixes:

    Fixed collision bugs in many levels
    Added missing chinese voices
    Fixed an issue causing the timer to not display properly
    Fixed an issue causing SteamVR to start on its own
    Modified player and projectiles physics to be more precise


Impulsion is now officially on speedrun.com !
You can check and submit your runs here: https://www.speedrun.com/Impulsion 

But most importantly, a Discord has been created for our community of players to share new ideas, strats, runs, bug reports, or just talk about the game !

Join us at: https://discord.gg/g5CDbhD


As we continue forward to grow our community, please don't hesitate to share your feedback on the Discord or in the Steam discussions so we can keep improving the game together.

Good Luck & Have Fun !
